# Graph.addVertex() method

Adds vertices with no edges.

**Signature:**

```typescript
addVertex(...vertex: T[]): Graph<T>;
```

**Returns:**

This graph, for chaining.

## Remarks

Not idempotent: a vertex that is already present has its edges RESET, so guard with [Graph.hasVertex()](/api/sequelize/latest/sequelize.graph.hasvertex/) when a vertex may already be there. Adding an edge from an unknown vertex adds it for you, which is the usual way one appears.
